sections.heading: Why visit Agra
paragraphs: Agra (Uttar Pradesh) is known for its heritage, city and culture experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to March.
